=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087), _clone_for_memory_branch at lines 3087-3090 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded into HTTPS git URLs used by clone/fetch operations.
  WHY: The token is exposed in subprocess arguments, temporary `.git/config`, and git error output or workflow logs, regressing the prior `http.extraHeader` authentication design.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 569-586); callers at lines 601, 624, 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick git URLs embed GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN and are passed to clone and push operations.
  WHY: The token persists in temporary clone configuration, appears in process arguments, and can leak through git stderr; this is a credential-hygiene regression.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: removal of is_sensitive_target_path (formerly lines 158-179), MAX_TARGET_PATHS / MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES (formerly lines 156-157), normalize_path at lines 237-247, emit_context loop at lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count/per-path-size limits were removed from targeted prompt-file assembly.
  WHY: Untrusted plans or issue/PR-derived paths can inline `.git/config`, `.env*`, and other credential-bearing files into the editor prompt before isolation; the severity was reported as MAJOR by deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and as BLOCKER by the other reviewers, so the highest severity is used.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: imports at lines 29-38; references at lines 694-722 and 769-777 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports and exercises removed MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path symbols.
  WHY: Test collection fails with ImportError, and the sensitive-path and path-limit contract tests cannot run.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: lines 51-55 and 95-98 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing hygiene tests reject token-bearing production URLs and require the removed _memory_git authentication wrapper.
  WHY: The edited production files match the forbidden token URL patterns and no longer contain the required wrapper call sites, so the assertions fail deterministically.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: line 1989 — `if git_with_github_auth push origin "HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH}"; then` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The unguarded judge-fix push still calls git_with_github_auth after its removal from scripts/gh_helpers.sh.
  WHY: The command returns 127, so judge-fix commits are not pushed and review-blocked remediation stalls.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch at lines 140-151 and 177-180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: memory_ensure_branch now performs bare git ls-remote and git push against a credential-free origin after _memory_git was removed.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, branch discovery and creation fail authentication and the fail-open path silently disables the ai-memory branch.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-64 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The preservation restore dropped `--staged`, and the cached cleanup fallback was removed.
  WHY: A staged modification or deletion of `pre_assembled_static.txt` remains in the index and can be committed despite the preservation step; severity was reported as MAJOR by minimax_minimax-m3 and x-ai_grok-4_6 and BLOCKER by qwen_qwen3_7-plus, so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: merge_with_followup successor block, lines 18094-18125 / 18107-18138, and analogous close_and_reissue block at 18180-18204 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Follow-up issue creation failures no longer emit the previous error log, Telegram WARNING, or explicit failure signal.
  WHY: After a merge, a transient issue-creation failure leaves the deferred gap untracked and operators unalerted.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: lines 252-258 — `chmod 0444 "${editor_opencode_config}"` | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generated editor configuration is made read-only and is not made writable before a retry regenerates it.
  WHY: The second editor attempt can fail with permission denied before invoking the model.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: lines 1928-1932 and 1961-1968 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Partial cleanup between editor attempts can leave the isolation state active while workspace restoration is incomplete.
  WHY: A subsequent EXIT-trap cleanup can fail and terminate the retry path instead of recovering from the partial mutation.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: removed git_with_github_auth function (was at old line 461-478 / formerly ~line 493); callers at review_rb_judge.sh:1989, 2382-2383 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A sourced helper identifier was removed while reachable consumers still reference it.
  WHY: Existing callers resolve a missing command, breaking the sourced-library contract and judge-fix pushes.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Load bootstrap and actuator scripts only from an immutable reviewed default-branch SHA, never the PR SHA."

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: test_git_auth_hygiene.py adds immutable-source enforcement coverage, but tests/test_targeted_file_context.py still imports and tests removed MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path symbols.
- requirement: "Install PR dependencies only in a disposable secretless job or container with no runner command files or shared Git metadata."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml "Install project dependencies (best-effort)" step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The step was removed entirely; the requirement is reported as satisfied.
- requirement: "Install PR dependencies only in a disposable secretless job or container with no runner command files or shared Git metadata."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh, and scripts/memory_helpers.sh / scripts/ai_memory_lib.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The install step was deleted, but token-bearing git commands still run in the privileged review job.
- requirement: "Launch the writer with an allowlisted environment, hide runner command files, and use an isolated worktree with inaccessible Git metadata."
  expected_change_site: scripts/targeted_file_context.py::normalize_path and the prompt assembly path in scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: editor isolation is present, but removal of sensitive-path filtering allows credential-bearing files to reach the prompt before isolation; the requirement is therefore only partially delivered.
- requirement: "Launch the writer with an allowlisted environment, hide runner command files, and use an isolated worktree with inaccessible Git metadata."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: setup_editor_isolation and the allowlisted env -i launch are present; chmod 0700 protects `.git` and runner command files, and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is the only allowlisted credential. The requirement is reported as implemented.
- requirement: "Accept deduplicated issues only when immutable creator identity, expected labels, action, and authenticated body digest all match."
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue and related helpers
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Signed successor intents and producer identity, label, canonical digest, and request-field validation are implemented; the requirement is reported as fully implemented.
- requirement: "Trust refusal markers only from the immutable actuator identity and bind them to a signed decision or request digest."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh review_blocked_refusal_is_valid; scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py sign-refusal and verify-refusal commands
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: V2 signed refusal envelopes, producer binding, HMAC verification, rotation, tamper detection, and V1 rejection tests are present; the requirement is reported as fully implemented.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
